question: An investigator is studying the interaction between a new drug B and an existing drug A. The results are recorded and plotted on the graph shown. Which of the following properties of drug B best explain the observed effect on the dose-response curve of drug A?
analysis: The observed effect on the dose-response curve of drug A suggests that drug B is affecting the response of drug A without competing for the same binding site. This indicates a non-competitive interaction between the two drugs.
